advance_commitment_note: This event had already taken place when the log was written, so committing the file cannot demonstrate that the predictions were made beforehand. The probabilities are still genuinely out-of-sample -- the model that produced them saw only fights dated strictly earlier -- but foresight is not what the commit timestamp establishes here.
disclaimer: Research backtest only. Not betting advice.
upcoming_data_note: No live source of upcoming cards is reachable: UFCStats serves a JavaScript proof-of-work challenge, and the odds project's upcoming.csv has been stale since 2026-04-04. Rather than invent fixtures or prices, completed events are replayed and labelled.
